entry.title: Team Fortress 2 Mann vs Machine v1.18.8r2
entry.content: ## Changes ### Fixed - **The debug bundle no longer tells Windows players to press Repair when Repair cannot help.** SigMod already checks the game files it reads, and when it finds them right the summary now says so, says the crash comes from SigMod on Windows, and explains how to play without it until a fix ships. - **The debug bundle sees a Linux server that crashes on `replay_srv.so`.** It used to report "nothing matched" while the server restarted every few seconds. It now names the error and gives the command that finds the missing 32-bit system library. ## Windows Download **`tf2ap.exe`** above. Run it. It installs everything else. Windows will warn you, and it is a false positive. The exe unpacks archives and starts a game server without a code signature, which looks like a virus to a scanner. Click **More info**, then **Run anyway**, or check it below first. [Full guide](https://m-this.github.io/tf2-archipelago/en/setup/install-windows.html) ## Linux Download **`tf2ap-linux-amd64`**. Run it. It installs everything else. ```sh chmod +x tf2ap-linux-amd64 ./tf2ap-linux-amd64 ``` [Full guide](https://m-this.github.io/tf2-archipelago/en/setup/install-linux.html) ## Docker Download **`compose.yaml`** and **`env.example`**: ```sh mkdir mann-vs-archipelago && cd mann-vs-archipelago base=https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/releases/latest/download curl -fsSLO "$base/compose.yaml" curl -fsSL -o .env "$base/env.example" ``` Set `SRCDS_RCONPW` in `.env`, then: ```sh docker compose --profile seed run --rm seed # writes ./seed docker compose up -d ``` Upload the file from `seed/` at [archipelago.gg/uploads](https://archipelago.gg/uploads) and put the room's port into `AP_PORT`. [Full guide](https://m-this.github.io/tf2-archipelago/en/setup/install.html) ## Other assets | File | For | | --- | --- | | `tf2_mvm.apworld` | The official Archipelago app. | | `tf2_archipelago.smx` | A SourceMod server the launcher and compose file don't manage. | | `tf2-defender-bots.zip` | The bots for that same server. Unzip into `tf/`. | | `meta.json`, `items.json`, `missions.json` | The item and check tables, for reference. | ## Checking what you downloaded **`SHA256SUMS`** is attached to this release. It holds the hash of every file here, computed by the workflow that built them. ```powershell Get-FileHash tf2ap.exe -Algorithm SHA256 # Windows ``` ```sh sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS --ignore-missing # Linux ``` Each binary carries a signed record of the commit and the workflow that built it: ```sh gh attestation verify tf2ap.exe --repo m-this/tf2-archipelago ``` The binaries are scanned on VirusTotal, and the reports are linked at the end of these notes. Expect a few heuristic detections and no named malware family. The source is all in the repository, and `make launcher` rebuilds the exe on your own machine. ## Code signing policy Free code signing for open source projects, provided by [SignPath.org](https://signpath.org), with a certificate from the [SignPath Foundation](https://signpath.org). > [!WARNING] > The application is open, not granted. Nothing is signed yet: `tf2ap.exe` ships > unsigned, and Windows warns about it until that changes. ## What's Changed * feat(stability): known-failure list for the daily report by @m-this in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/259 **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/compare/v1.18.7...v1.18.8 ## VirusTotal - [`tf2ap.exe`](https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file-analysis/ZDc0MmUwOTljODE3Mzk3NDlmMDMwZTUwMTY1NDZhZjI6MTc5NDU5Mjg0OA==/detection) - [`tf2ap-linux-amd64`](https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file-analysis/NTZiMGIxMTBhYThlMTczYWY4NTFmYjExOTJlZjQwMzg6MTc5NDU5Mjg1MQ==/detection)

entry.title: One Piece Unlimited Cruise 1 v1.0.0
entry.content:
This week's update is... **SUPER!** :star: There are a handful of major features within this update, as well as some extra options and QoL changes! This is our first build I'm happy to call feature complete!
> Generate a new seed with this version and the new `OPUC1.yaml`. Older YAMLs fall back to the defaults for the new options.
## What's New? ### **The Cave Isle, The Underwater Passage** The main feature of this update, adds the 4th Island to the run, meaning all Islands are in the Archipelago! This means Locations for all the bosses, ambushes, shrines, stone monuments, treasure chests, as well as new locations for Usopp's Workshop / Sanji's Kitchen / Chopper's Pharmacy / Fishsanity / Creaturesanity with all the Cave Isle has to offer. Moles are finally in logic with the addition of the Cave Isle, so all the Obstructed Path Build Sites on the other Islands can now be accessed, adding Nightmare Luffy, Rampaging Chopper and all sorts of other Chests and Monuments into Logic.
### **Franky's Supplies & Extra Recipes** Our 2nd biggest addition this update! After digging into the menu data, I managed to find quite a bit of early development data for UC2, including the 2nd Development Menu, left completely unused in UC1. I've added this menu into the game as a 4th crafting menu that you access via the Side Doors on the Sunny, replacing the Storage's Touchspots. Here, you can trade in Old Gold Coins for various items that can be pretty tedious to get normally, such as Dial Fragments. This menu also has 20+ Archipelago Item crafting recipes. A New Feature has been added called "Extra Recipes", which fills in the rest of the 32-slot crafting menus for Development/Cooking/Pharmacy, adding **30+** new Crafting Recipes for Archipelago Items! The Materials needed for both these new Extra Recipes as well as all the Archipelago Items in Franky's Supplies are randomized at seed generation! *(You can still access the Storage via the Menu)*
This is a completely separate crafting menu from Usopp's Workshop, so instead of Art of Development, the required skill to level up to unlock more recipes is Franky's Supply Skill, which has been renamed to "Art of Supplying". It still reduces Build Site costs as usual. Old Gold Coins have become a lot easier to find when Franky's Supplies is enabled. The following changes get applied: - The Flour/Hardtack Ration Barrels have a 50% chance to drop Old Gold Coins instead. - Golden Hercules now drop 1-5 Old Gold Coins instead of Sticky Sap. *(You can still obtain Sticky Sap from regular Hercules Beetles. Sticky Sap is also one of the trade items you can receive from Franky's Supplies)* - All the "Junk" Salvage Items you pick up from Fishing become Old Gold Coins. - The Sea Anemones on the Cave Isle drop Old Gold Coins instead of Black Orbs. - Thousand Sunny's dust spots drop Old Gold Coins instead. - Old Gold Coins have also been added to the "Other Items" filler pool. *(Including Packages)*
### **Energy Link Support** Energy Link has been added! A tab has been added to the client, where you can manage Gabri's 6 energy bars. Gabri takes 100 Energy to fill a bar. For Energy Link, 1 Energy = 10 MJ, so 1 bar of Gabri Energy is 1 GJ. There is a 20% cut when converting. Gold Energy takes twice as much to fill, but also gives out twice the amount of energy when converting. This makes grinding energy a lot smoother, as you can move energy between the bars, so I highly recommend using this option even if this is the only game using Energy Link.
### **Other New Features/Options** - **Archipelago Client Icon** - The ONE PIECE: Unlimited Cruise 1 AP Client now has a unique icon in the Archipelago Launcher. - **In-Game Archipelago Messages** - Items you receive or send to other players will be displayed as text in-game. *(You can tweak it/turn it off via the OPUC1 Client)* - **Extra Final Door Requirement** - You can choose if you want to defeat all Island Bosses/All Bosses, before goaling. - **Gabri Energy Items** - You can now choose to have all Gabri Level Ups to be per colour. - **How Many Gabri Level Items** - You can choose how many of those per colour upgrades exist. - **Starting Gabri Energy** - You can choose your starting Gabri Energy. *(always starting with at least 1 Blue Energy to avoid getting hard gated in the Prologue)* - **The Wherever Cannon** - You can choose if the Wherever Cannon is unlocked via completing its Build Site, or have it be directly unlocked on the Sunny upon finding the AP item. - **Materialsanity** - Adds 40 "Got" Locations for first-time pick up of a Material. - **Expanded Storage** - The Storage can now hold up to 45 Items. - **Easier Fish** - Fish have a 50% weaker pull strength when reeling in. - **Better Plant Drop Rates** - Now includes Ashes and Mysterious Seaweed *(both now 80% drop rate from their natural sources)*
### Known Issue Don't load a save after quitting to the title screen - it can hang on a black screen. Close the game, start it again (client at the title screen) and load from there. Your save is fine.

entry.title: Kirby & The Amazing Mirror v0.5.1rc2
entry.content:
## v0.5.1-rc2
Release candidate for v0.5.1, built from merged main commit `9b4aaa513d8aed325f4ecf32c2a39eb1bf018961`.
### Changes since v0.5.0 - Copy Ability Room access is now an AP item (Issue #1002). - Improved Logic for Item Placement and Accessible Locations (PR #1041, #1042, #1045, #1048, #1051, #1052). - Starting inventory: Ice added; Beam kept; Wheel, Mini, Cutter, Stone and Burning removed. - Fixed starting-inventory counts and native enemy behavior overwriting shuffled abilities, including Waddle Doo/Parasol resets. - **New in rc2:** Carrot and Radish chute-side barriers now require their corresponding Lever Wall items. Same-side returns and room visits remain available; all four lever chains were audited (Issue #1093, PR #1094).
Regenerate seeds to use the corrected placement logic. Updating the APWorld does not rewrite existing generated seeds or spoilers.
### Downloads - **kirbyam.apworld**: the installable Kirby & the Amazing Mirror world package for Archipelago, including the committed ROM patch. This is the file players need; it does not contain a full game ROM. - **kirbyam.provenance.json**: build receipt identifying the source commit, workflow run and package checksum; useful for verification, not required for normal play. - **kirbyam.attestation.jsonl**: signed GitHub build-provenance bundle for verifying the package and receipt; not a game file. - **Source code (zip / tar.gz)**: GitHub-generated repository snapshots for developers, not substitutes for the installable APWorld.
### Known limitations Only the North American ROM is supported. AP notifications are English; mGBA notifications require the visible Archipelago Connector scripting panel. Original chest/statue visuals remain. Ranged-attack logic still has coverage gaps. Testing covers selected scenarios, not a complete playthrough or every multiplayer setup; the Carrot barrier correction has static geometry/regression coverage but not a fresh native closed/open comparison.
[Full v0.5.1 changelog](https://github.com/hasherwi/Archipelago-kirbyam/blob/kirbyam-v0.5.1-rc2/worlds/kirbyam/CHANGELOG.md)

entry.title: Dark Souls Remastered v0.3.0
entry.content:
# Version 0.3.0 - AP Icon, Regional and Categorical Shuffle options, New Weapon Upgrade System ### Version update -> 0.3.0. **Client is _NOT_ compatible with 0.2.x generated apworlds**. **Make sure your host generates with the v0.3.0 apworld**.
### Features * Add **AP icon via optional patch** `APIconPatch.apdsr` - see Setup Guide for more details. Huge thanks to Nave for this! * Yaml options: **Optional Region selection** - explicit selection for DLC, Painted Work, and Great Hollow+Ash Lake. Unshuffled regions will not have their bosses removed for the `all_bosses` goal. * Yaml options: Toggleable **shuffling by location category** (subcategories of Corpse items/One-time Enemy drops, etc). For categories without prog items, includes an option for Local-only Randomization. `/lrspoiler` command added to check where local items are randomized from and to. * By customizing these options, you can both decrease filler item bloat in the multiworld _and_ lower your check count, which can play better with other worlds/significantly reduce how long a run takes. * Yaml option: `lord_soul_shuffle`, to **allow lord souls to be unshuffled**. * **Location Groups** added for locations by category (see updated list in Game Info page). * If `ornstein_and_smough` is chosen as goal, all locations considered "post o+s" (the lordvessel and any locations requiring the lordvessel) will not be shuffled. If catacombs is put behind o+s in logic, it will also not be shuffled. * Yaml Options: **Weapon upgrade system Updated**! Now `Progressive Incoming Weapon Upgrade`s - in the same style as the Soul and Weight Multiplier options. Defaults on with 5 steps, going from +0 to +15. Only affects items received via AP once the relevant progressive items are received. Does not affect items from unrandomized or local_only-randomized locations. * "Collect" Support included from experimental v0.2.6.2 below.
### Fixes * Fully rewrote/Changed method of flag polling/location checking - Drastically reducing number of memory reads in DSR process and improving performance by up to 160x. * Removed network delay on item popups for others & self * Refactored boss tracking - when bosses are killed, it will sync that they were killed between all saves. * Fix Typo on "Kalameet" in location name "RW: Gough's Great Arrow - Kalemeet's Arena" * Adjust firekeeper soul location in BT so it doesn't trigger Lautrec killing Anastacia

entry.title: Slime Rancher 2 v0.17.0
entry.content:
## New Features - The mod now supports automatic reconnection - Mod attempts to reconnect after 2, 5, 10, 20, and then every 30 seconds while disconnected - Check locations still work while disconnected - Retries stop on Save/Quit, connection to a server with a different seed, or refused login (password added/removed while disconnected) - New Setting: `treasure_pod_keys` - Enabling this setting will either add a global unlock key or one per-region which blocks opening Treasure Pods until obtained. - New Setting: `drone_access_key` - Enabling this setting will add a new item which blocks opening Research Drones until obtained. *These two settings will hopefully provide a good option to break up the potentially large Sphere 1 that SR2 can have* - New Setting: `prisma_shards_exact` - Forces game generation to include the number of Prisma Shards you want rather than culling based on the location count of the game. - Most useful in solo games or games with very few filler locations available. - Generation will throw an error telling you how many locations are missing if all shards cannot be placed
## Quality of Life Updates - Added information on the number of checks that are influenced by each setting in the apworld - Updated how locked location popups were formatted to make them easier to read/understand - Updated the error message thrown when a game fails to generate due to too few locations
## Performance Improvements - Updated how the Vacpack Spew Trap works to reduce game impact when lots of items are ejected - Updated how the mod scans for available Research Drones and Plort Doors to reduce the number of calls made - Fixed how the pause menu goal display checks for whether or not it should display *These should help improve performance in areas like the Grey Labyrinth which pull in a large amount of things to check all at once*
## Logic Fixes - Updated Jetpack logic for Dash Boots II and Pulse Wave craft locations - Explicitly added Jetpack requirements for all Powderfall Bluffs locations to account for the `bundled` region access mode - *Logic is not yet in place for the aurora bridges in Powderfall Bluffs. This means that more locations are technically available sooner than the logic expects. This will be updated in a future release* - Golden Sureshot III now correctly requires access to either Ember Valley or Starlight Strand

entry.title: Grand Theft Auto III v0.4.0
entry.content:
Weapon licenses, a save file between sessions, and $10000 to fill the pool. Use the plugin and the APWorld of this release together, and generate a new room for it.
## What's new
- **Weapon licenses**: nine weapons the shops sell are items (Uzi, shotgun, AK-47, M-16, sniper rifle, rocket launcher, flamethrower, Molotov cocktail, grenade). A shop shows the weapon out of stock until you receive its license; the pistol and the body armour are sold as in the game. - **$10000**: the only extra item, which fills the rest of the pool. - **Excluded locations** (`exclude_locations`): each one takes the place of a license, from the grenade's back, and gets a $10000; that weapon is then sold as in the game. A room of GTA III alone can fill 9 at most. - **`start_inventory_from_pool`**: start with items taken out of the pool, like `Uzi License: 1`; each one leaves a $10000 in its place. - **Between sessions**: GTA3 Client keeps your money, health, armour and weapons in a save file of its own, one per room (`gta3_saves` in Archipelago's folder). A new game started with **Run Archipelago** gets them back, with the items received in the meantime, and never gives an item twice. - **Received items**: items that arrive together show in one message, for 3 seconds; a new message takes the place of the previous one.
## Known limitations
- The missions passed do not come back between sessions: a new game starts the story again. Play a run in one session for now. - Saving and loading a game is not supported yet. - Only `gta3.exe` 1.0 is supported: downgrade the Steam copy first (see the README's *Steam version* section). - With `need_money` on, the logic counts no money: you may have to earn it in the game. - Played far out of the story's order, a mission may still rely on something an earlier one sets up. Please report the ones that break.
## Installation
You need GTA III for PC **version 1.0**, Archipelago **0.6.7** or newer, and the ASI loader [Ultimate ASI Loader](https://github.com/ThirteenAG/Ultimate-ASI-Loader/releases/latest/download/Ultimate-ASI-Loader.zip) (32-bit, `Ultimate-ASI-Loader.zip`, not the `_x64` one).
1. Put the `dinput8.dll` of `Ultimate-ASI-Loader.zip` next to `gta3.exe`. 2. Put `GTA3Archipelago.asi` in the `scripts` folder next to `gta3.exe` (create it if needed). 3. Double-click `gta3.apworld` to install it in Archipelago, or copy it into Archipelago's `custom_worlds` folder. 4. Write your YAML (`game: Grand Theft Auto III`, with the options of the README) and generate or join a room. 5. Open **GTA3 Client** from the Archipelago Launcher and connect to the room. 6. Start GTA III and choose **Run Archipelago** in the main menu. Keep GTA3 Client open while you play.
Coming from 0.3.0: replace both files with this release's, and generate a new room.
## Files
- `GTA3Archipelago.asi`: the game plugin, for the `scripts` folder. - `gta3.apworld`: the GTA III world and GTA3 Client, for Archipelago. - `README.md`: how it plays, the options, and the full installation guide. - `LICENSE-MinHook.txt`: the license of MinHook, which the plugin contains.

entry.title: Nine Sols v0.7.0
entry.content:
For installation instructions [see the README](https://github.com/Ixrec/NineSolsArchipelagoRandomizer?tab=readme-ov-file#installation).
- **Entrance randomization** is finally here. - The new options are `randomize_entrances` (default false, obviously) and `coupled_entrances` (default true). If you weren't aware: "coupled" ER guarantees that whenever A goes to B, B also goes back to A. Uncoupled ER is much harder to navigate. - `randomize_entrances: true` randomizes 51 two-way connections and 4 one-way connections between areas. Or to put it another way: there are 106 portals you can run or fall into which (after a loading screen) take you somewhere different than they did in vanilla. - Many other connections are intentionally left unrandomized. Examples include the Central Hall connections to FSP and Control Hub/Eigong, the Jiequan 1 fight into Prison, Lady E's soulscape entrance, the big elevators that have more than two destinations, the connections between each part of Peach Blossom Village, and the doors into various "puzzle rooms" and "enemy gauntlet rooms". - Universal Tracker support has also been updated for ER. For now this is only "basic" ER support, i.e. whether a square is red or green should correctly account for how the entrances have been randomized in your slot, but none of UT's ER-specific features have been implemented yet.

Day-one patch for Version 0.3. Fixes a major apworld issue wherein a large portion of the map is incorrectly marked as in-logic at the start of the game.
Players on active games generated through the v0.3.0 apworld should request server-sending of the following items for correct Sphere 1 access: `Terminal 1`, `Terminal 3`.
All other players and hosts should update to the v0.3.1 apworld as soon as possible. The v0.3.1 mod is unchanged from the previous release.
### Fixed - The Abbey Great Door is now marked as passable only if the Terminal 3 puzzle can be solved.

entry.title: Animal Crossing v0.6.0rc1
entry.content:
This is a RELEASE CANDIDATE for 0.6.0, which means don't play this version unless you're OK with potential crashes and graphical issues and want to report them to help me get the release ready!
If you do want to help, **set your graphics to Vulkan in the Video settings menu**. Then, open an issue or send a message in the Archipelago discord if you run into issues. Include your OS and your graphics card, and ofc what happened.
- **Update to SDL3:** you shouldn't notice any difference, but this is a newer backend library and may bring more compatibility with newer setups (old setups should not change; if they do let me know). - If you are on Linux + Wayland, it will now use the native Wayland output instead of X11 through a translation layer - With the update to SDL3, **button positions are now used instead of face label**. In practice, this means that you will get the Nintendo layout regardless of controller. It is easy to restore with the controller setup; just part of SDL3 (sorry). - **New Vulkan Renderer:** alternative to OpenGL if you find OpenGL buggy (or laggy? they should be roughly the same speed though) - **Easier Critters Upgrade:** bugs can now spawn on ANY flower (old AC they can't spawn on tulips) and will spawn on the outer 2 rows/columns of an acre (they couldn't in the original). - **Fossil tracker:** new fossil tracker like bugs, fish, and shells in the AP pause menu - **Crash fix outdoors:** crash from outdoor furniture fixed (random) - **Missing critter fix:** under rare circumstances, the last bug in a spawn table may never spawn. it should now - **Fix may windsocks:** they properly spawn and despawn now - **Fix birthday + starsign:** showed as 'iiiiiiiii' if you had instant text on - **Timesanity forces bugs cleanly into time slots:** before, you could catch some bugs "out of logic" for 1 hour, which might've been confusing - **Mini tracker shows shells + more consistent found/available output** - **More lenient generation:** if random is selected for pools where the final result could be beyond the allowed amount, the random value is rerolled to fit into the proper range. Also, goal: random doesn't choose goals that can't work with the current settings - **Pushing or pulling furniture no longer carries you across an acre:** sorry, it was very broken - **Precompiled shaders option** - **Show graphics error if OpenGL 3.3 not found** - **More information when a ROM doesn't match or is not found**

entry.title: Cyberpunk 2077 v0.7.6
entry.content:
## APWorld bugfix
- Removed the three "Little China Melee Vendor (2)" checks (`Vendors.wat_lch_melee_02`). The vendor record exists in the game files, but no NPC is placed in Watson, so those checks could never be collected and would block a full clear or auto-release. Coach Fred is the only Little China melee vendor. - Include Melee Vendors is now 18 checks (was 21).
## Compatibility
- APWorld-only update. The game mod is unchanged, so mod 0.7.4 keeps working. The mod ZIP attached here is a rebuild of the same mod. - All other location IDs are unchanged. The three removed IDs (2077412-2077414) are reserved and will not be reused. - Seeds generated on an older APWorld still contain those 3 checks. They only ever hold filler, so it's safe to skip them. - Minimum Archipelago version is still 0.6.6.
